name: intervox
description: Voice engine with a closed loop: generate and edit prose in your voice, then verify it against your measured fingerprint. Register-aware profile (Team/Internal/External/Open Source), stylometric baseline, LLMism linter, exemplar retrieval, critique-revise apply. Successor to interfluence and intervoice.
author: mistakeknot
